name: Hereditary Diameter Optimality
statement: A finite class $C\subseteq\{0,1\}^X$ belongs to the class when it is ample and every pc-minor $M$ of $C$, including $C$ itself, has maximum Hamming diameter among all ample classes on the same displayed ground set with shattering complex $\operatorname{Sh}(M)$.
hypotheses: Finite binary class; pc-minors are obtained by coordinate fixings and coordinate projections.
comments: This is the diameter-based definition. The analogous hereditary minimum-maximum-degree condition is presently conjectural.
